Gifted: Undo.name: Gifted: Undo
Gifted: Undo.description:
🧬 Undo, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 A shattered window stands whole, a bent bar straightens, a spilled bag repacks, and scattered pieces fly back, striking whatever stands in the way.
📈 Training adds closing a breach around a villain, making an armed bomb safe, raising a fallen stair, undoing a crushed car around its riders, rebuilding part of a house.
⚠️ Living bodies are out of reach: wounds, ages and Quirks never answer, and a body in the way stops the returning pieces.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding the earlier shape of things in mind blurs your own last few minutes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eri (Rewind), which works on living bodies; this one cannot.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Undo.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Undo family): Scale: by touch the user restores a non-living object's shape, wholeness and contents from any moment in the last minute. A new adult user undoes up to door or motorbike size. The object stays put; its broken or fallen pieces from that span fly back, bruising anyone between. Touch also senses whether and how it changed. Longer spans, larger objects need techniques. Limits: no living bodies, the user's included (wounds, age, illness, Quirks); clothing only once removed. Returning pieces press around a living body without crushing. Used-up things never return (burned fuel, eaten food, fired shots); older changes are final. Quirk Strain: light: mend, recall; moderate: closed breach, defused device, raised stair; heavy: crushed vehicle, rubble recall; severe: signature reset, rebuilding a house. Type: Emitter. Law: undoing crime-scene evidence is tampering; police suspect a registered Undo user near a tidied scene until cleared.
